titulo: Why GTA Studio Co-Founder Is Avoiding GTA 6–And All Open-World Games
texto: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser left the company in 2020 and now runs a new outfit called Absurd Ventures. Houser will be forever connected to the GTA franchise, and he's now weighed in on GTA 6 . He told Variety that he did not watch the "Extended Look" trailer and doesn't plan to. Why? He said he tries to avoid consuming things that are going to "disrupt me creatively." "And given that I spend a large amount of time trying to make open-world games, and the rest of my conscious time trying to figure out innovative ways to market them, I don’t need to see what other people are [doing]," he said. "I’m always trying to think about new ways of doing it, not sit there in some kind of comparison of what I would have done differently.” Also in the interview, Houser said he doesn't play a lot of open-world games anymore, for similar reasons. titulo: How Is A Game Like GTA 6 Actually Made? Here’s How Rockstar Gets It Done
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most highly anticipated game releases this year, or ever. The franchise is known for its massive scope and impressive attention to detail, but how is a game like GTA 6 actually made? In a new interview with Love magazine ( via Kotaku ), Rockstar North boss Rob Nelson said that part of the secret sauce with the GTA franchise is that many of its developers have been working together for a long time and have a "good sense of what they need to do." In terms of actually building the game, Nelson said the process begins by creating assets and systems, and then "roughing in content across all areas of development." More specifically, Nelson said GTA 6 was built through a series of eight-week milestones where select pieces of the game are compiled together.
